integrity: The infinite result is proved analytically. Exhaustive computations through length 22 are supplementary checks, not substitutes for proof. The review explicitly credits the fixed-universality extremal framework in prior work and isolates the new fixed-length parity law.
limitations: The theorem concerns binary words and shortest absent subsequences only. It does not classify all extremizers, and an older equivalent fixed-length statement under different subsequence-universality terminology remains a residual originality risk.
title: Fibonacci extremals for shortest absent subsequences of binary words
